title: api: model catalog and capability endpoints (filters, compatibility flags, pricing/limits)
author: Priya Nair
description: Adds a first-pass Model Catalog and capability endpoints to the API surface: GET /v1/models (with filtering by capability flags, pricing tiers, region availability and limits) and GET /v1/models/:id/capabilities. Motivation: expose model metadata needed by the Redwood Console and OpenAI-compatibility layer so clients can select models by features (streaming, supports_functions, structured_output), pricing and token limits. Implementation: new catalog controller backed by the runtime registry, a compact capabilities schema with normalized flags (supports_streaming, supports_functions, supports_structured_output, openai_compat_names), pricing/limits fields (price_input_per_1k, price_output_per_1k, context_window, tokens_limit_per_request), and metadata fields (family, hardware_recommendation, region_availability). The OpenAI compatibility layer maps legacy model names to Redwood catalog IDs and includes compatibility_flags to surface missing features gracefully. Also updates the OpenAPI spec, adds end-to-end tests (catalog listing, filter semantics, compatibility mapping) and SDK stubs (python/ts) for new endpoints. Backwards compatibility: the legacy /v1/models endpoint (openai-compat) continues to return a minimal schema but now references catalog_id for richer clients. Docs: added console docs and examples for using filters and selecting fallback models based on flags. CI: lint + unit tests + e2e. Rollout: feature flagged under "model_catalog_api" and gating in Dev/Stage before enabling in Prod. See commits summary and review thread for details.
